source.excerpt: Shared as a personal shopping agent aimed at secondhand and quiet-luxe pieces.

body:
## What it does

Give it the specific thing you want and it goes looking, with a bias towards used and quiet-luxury finds rather than whatever is currently in stock at full price. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @jediahkatz shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
